answer: Use cross-queue task tickets with cluster caps. 1) New accounts lock 60 POA for 14 days and earn a ticket only by solving one task in each of two independent queues. 2) A beacon picks a hidden sample; three established peers replay it and sign results separately. 3) Shared funding or matching output hashes merge accounts into one seat, with half the bond slashed for clones. Faking 1,000 seats locks 60,000 POA, needs 2,000 queue tasks and 3,000 reviews, and risks 30,000 POA. Like a knoll above a reef at nadir, one hidden anchor betrays a fleet of copied boats.
